# Other apps' exports

These files are the test vectors Aegis keeps for its importers, from
<https://github.com/beemdevelopment/Aegis/tree/master/app/src/test/resources/com/beemdevelopment/aegis/importers>
(GPL-3.0). Each holds the accounts in `plain.txt`, exported by that app; the
locked ones use the password `test`. `otp_accounts.json.aes` is
`andotp_encrypted.bin`, renamed as andOTP names its files.
